author: ComradeCactus
description: Generate images with a self-hosted Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111) web UI via its API. Supports SDXL mode, retrieving previous tasks, and showing the current model.
install_msg: Use `[p]webui setwebui <host>` to point the cog at your Stable Diffusion web UI, then `[p]generate fromprompt` to create images.
short: Generate art with a self-hosted Stable Diffusion web UI
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only the configured web UI host and SDXL setting. Prompts are sent to the configured Stable Diffusion host to generate images; no end user data is persistently stored.
